[project]
name = "backend"
version = "1.7.0"
description = "Backend"
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.12"
dependencies = [
    "dj-rest-auth>=7.0.1",
    "django>=5.2,<5.3",
    "django-cors-headers>=4.6.0",
    "django-cors-headers>=4.6.0",
    "django-json-widget>=2.0.0",
    "djangorestframework>=3.15.2",
    "djangorestframework-gis>=1.1",
    "djangorestframework-simplejwt>=5.5.0",
    "drf-spectacular>=0.27",
    "docutils>=0.21.2",
    "geopandas>=1.1.0",
    "gunicorn>=23.0.0",
    "networkx>=3.4.2",
    "openpyxl>=3.1.5",
    "pathvalidate>=3.3.1",
    "psycopg[binary]>=3.2.4",
    "python-dotenv>=1.0.1",
    "requests>=2.32.3",
    "sqlalchemy>=2.0.41",
    "owslib>=0.31.0",
    "cryptography>=42.0.0",
    "django-simple-history>=3.11.0",
]

[dependency-groups]
dev = [
    "factory-boy>=3.3.3",
    "pytest>=8.3.5",
    "pytest-cov>=6.0.0",
    "pytest-django>=4.11.1",
    "ruff>=0.11.4",
]

[tool.coverage.run]
source = ["apps.api"]
omit = [
    "*/tests/*",
    "*/migrations/*",
    "*/apps.py",
    "*/admin.py",
    "*/__init__.py",
]

[tool.coverage.report]
show_missing = true
skip_covered = false
exclude_lines = [
    "pragma: no cover",
    "def __repr__",
    "raise NotImplementedError",
    "if TYPE_CHECKING:",
    "if __name__ == .__main__.:",
]

{
	"name": "frontend",
	"private": true,
	"version": "1.7.0",
	"type": "module",
	"scripts": {
		"dev": "vite dev",
		"build": "vite build",
		"preview": "vite preview",
		"prepare": "svelte-kit sync || echo ''",
		"paraglide": "paraglide-js compile --project ./project.inlang --outdir ./src/lib/paraglide --strategy localStorage baseLocale",
		"generate:types": "openapi-typescript ../backend/schema.yml -o src/lib/types/api.d.ts",
		"format": "prettier --write .",
		"lint": "prettier --check .",
		"lint:ts": "eslint \"src/**/*.{ts,svelte}\"",
		"check": "npm run paraglide && svelte-kit sync && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json",
		"check:watch": "npm run paraglide && svelte-kit sync && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json --watch",
		"test:unit": "vitest",
		"test": "npm run test:unit -- --run",
		"test:coverage": "vitest --run --coverage"
